scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Do you want to
sing a song with me?
Sha la la la la~
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
你想和我一起唱歌吗？
啦啦啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
The dreary world
of mortals is in need
of more cheerful song.
Will you bring it to them
and turn the tide in the
battle against evil?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
凡人的世界
需要更多欢快的歌声。
你能将歌声带给他们，
扭转与邪恶战斗的局势吗？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Will you do this
for Midgard...
As a Minstrel?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
你愿意为了米德加尔特...
作为宫廷乐师这样做吗？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
当你准备好的时候，
随时欢迎回来。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回来之前
用完你剩余的所有技能点。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Congratulations!
As a Minstrel, your
your songs will bring
hope to your allies, and
desperation to your foes.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
恭喜！
作为宫廷乐师，你的歌声
将为盟友带来希望，
让敌人陷入绝望。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
欢迎来到英灵殿，
荣誉之厅。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
请在这里
随意休息。
向战士们致敬！
